metadata.title: Create Test Plan from LLD
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create comprehensive test plans from user story Low-Level Design (LLD) documents by analyzing requirements, designing test cases, and optionally syncing with external test management tools. Use when a user story has an approved LLD and needs comprehensive test planning, or when existing test cases need updating based on new features or LLD changes.

userStoryId.description: ID/reference of the user story (e.g., ADO work item ID, JIRA ticket)

lldPath.description: Path to the LLD document (relative to project root)

testPlanId.description: Existing test plan ID to update (for incremental updates)

parameters.notes: Test types, formats, and sync configuration are handled via guidelines rather than runtime parameters

guidelines.name: how-to-write-test-plan.md
guidelines.purpose: Comprehensive guide for test plan creation: test types, test case format/structure, documentation standards, naming conventions
guidelines.defaultBehavior: Generate functional, integration, and edge-case tests with standard format

guidelines.name: how-to-check-existing-test-cases.md
guidelines.purpose: How to find and compare existing test cases (location, matching criteria)
guidelines.defaultBehavior: Check local plans/ folder for existing test-plan.md files

guidelines.name: how-to-sync-test-management.md
guidelines.purpose: How to sync with external test management tools (Azure DevOps, Zephyr, TestRail)

steps.name: Init Process Principles
steps.description: Load and confirm the 8 operating principles for this process execution

steps.name: Understand LLD Context
steps.description: Parse and understand the LLD document to identify scope for test planning. Extract feature overview, technical implementation details, component interactions, data flows, API contracts, and integration points.

context.focusAreas: Feature scope, technical design, APIs, data flows, error handling

steps.name: Gather Test Requirements
steps.description: Extract and organize test-specific requirements from the LLD: acceptance criteria, edge cases, boundary conditions, integration points, test data requirements, error handling scenarios.

steps.name: Create Test Plan
steps.description: Analyze test scope and create the complete test plan document. Includes: analyzing scope, determining required test cases, checking for existing test cases (using guideline), creating/updating test cases, and compiling the test plan document.
postApprovalActions: Proceed to sync step if configured

steps.name: Sync to Test Management Tool
steps.description: Push test cases to external test management tool (Azure DevOps, Zephyr, TestRail) based on guideline configuration.
steps.output: Sync report with test case IDs and status
steps.conditional: Only executes if sync is configured in how-to-sync-test-management.md guideline
steps.notes: Conditional step - skipped if no sync configured

steps.name: Continuous Improvement
steps.description: Review the process execution and capture learnings: what worked well, what could be improved, suggested enhancements to guidelines or process.

steps.name: End Process Validation
steps.description: Final compliance check to ensure all process requirements were met.

informationProduced: Existing vs new test case analysis
